question: How do they match annotators to instances?

answer.free_form_answer: Annotations from experts are used if they have already been collected.
evidence: So far a system was trained on one type of data, either labeled by crowd or experts. We now examine the performance of a system trained on data that was routed to either experts or crowd annotators depending on their predicted difficult. Given the results presented so far mixing annotators may be beneficial given their respective trade-offs of precision and recall. We use the annotations from experts for an abstract if it exists otherwise use crowd annotations. The results are presented in Table 6 .

title: Predicting Annotation Difficulty to Improve Task Routing and Model Performance for Biomedical Information Extraction
answer_short: by routing instances predicted to be difficult to domain experts and easier ones to crowd annotators
answer_rationale: Text 5 and Text 8 state that using difficulty scores to assign instances to appropriate annotators is an effective strategy, with Text 5 specifically mentioning routing difficult instances to domain experts and easier ones to crowd annotators. Text 8 reinforces this by stating that simulations routing difficult examples to experts and others to crowd annotators yield the best results.
